answer: Proof-of-sustained-bandwidth resists sybils: each epoch the verifier streams an unpredictable high-rate challenge every identity must echo within a tight latency window, proving it can anchor a full dedicated link at that moment. One uplink cannot serve K fakes at the summit of the burst at once — the shared pipe saturates and responses miss the window. Throughput, not identity count, caps an operator; reaching the zenith of reward needs one real link per fake, which a farm cannot clone.
